units: Orl. III, 1 בגד שצְבָעוֹ וכ׳ a garment which one dyed with shells of fruits forbidden as ‘Orlah (v. עָרְלָה).
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 7:2">Sabb. VII, 2</cite> <he>והצוֹבְעוֹ</he> and he who dyes it (the wool).

<cite ref="Shabbat 75a">Ib. 75ᵃ</cite>, sq., a. fr. (<he>חייב</he>) <he>משום צוֹבֵעַ</he> he is guilty because it is an act coming under the category of dyeing; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 6:1:5">Y. Sabb. VI, 7ᵈ</cite> <he>צובעין תותבן</he>, read: <he>צבעונין או זהובין</he>, v. <cite ref="R00063"><he>צִבְעוֹן</he></cite>.]—V. <cite ref="R00159"><he>צוֹבַע</he></cite>.—Part. pass. <cite ref="R00025"><he>צָבוּעַ</he></cite>; f. <he>צְבוּעָה</he>; pl. <cite ref="R00026"><he>צְבוּעִים</he></cite>, <he>צְבוּעִין</he>; <he>צְבוּעוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 2:7">Num. R. s. 2</cite> <he>מפה שלו צ׳ אדום</he> his flag was red-colored.
<cite ref="Mishnah Megillah 4:7">Meg. IV, 7</cite> <he>מי שהיו ידיו צ׳ וכ׳</he> he whose hands are spotted from handling woad; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Sotah 22b:6">Sot. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>הצ׳</he> the painted (hypocrites), v. <cite ref="Q01738"><he>פָּרוּשׁ</he></cite>.—V. <cite ref="R00025"><he>צָבוּעַ</he></cite>.
